title: Scope the created Scene id to its Show

claims.statement: Claude Code (claude-code) is the source-producing agent for CHG-0057 under human principal @rodrigoteamx, on the 2026-08-24 directive to advance the Scene id-scoping node. This does not authorize automatic merge of CHG-0057.
claims.evidence: AGENTS.md, profile.json actors and the 2026-08-24 user directive.

claims.statement: CHG-0056 recorded that the create-Scene endpoint derived the Scene id from the name slug alone, so creating a same-named Scene in two different Shows produced one id and the second creation rebound the earlier Scene's channel — a cross-Show collision.
claims.evidence: server/src/routes/collections.ts create-Scene id before this change and CHG-0056 deferred unknown.

claims.statement: The fix makes the created Scene id Show-scoped (the name slug combined with the Show slug), so same-named Scenes in different Shows are independent and never collide, each bound to its own Show.

Governed discovery reordered the node to its minimal slice: the reported defect was the id collision, not the absence of Templates, so the slice fixes the id scoping and defers Template-based creation.
claims.evidence: Governed-discovery reorder check on 2026-08-24 and CHG-0056.

claims.statement: A Show-scoped Scene id proven distinct across Shows and bound to each Show closes the collision without a first-class Scene-id registry or optimistic concurrency.

Human review accepted CHG-0057: the created Scene id is Show-scoped, so same-named Scenes in different Shows are independent and never collide, each bound to its own Show. Template-based Scene creation stays deferred.
claims.evidence: server/src/routes/collections.ts, server/tests/unit/sceneIdScoping.test.ts, the passing full server suite under npm run check, the CHG-0057 pull-request Constitution run (all eight jobs), and human acceptance on 2026-08-24.

claims.statement: The change is a single-line id derivation plus the Studio New Scene test's expected id; no other behavior changes.
claims.evidence: git diff of the CHG-0057 branch and the pull-request validate job.

claims.statement: Template-based Scene creation (choosing a Template rather than blank) remains unimplemented; only blank creation exists.
claims.evidence: studio/src/views/ScenesView.vue createScene creates a blank named Scene only.

successCriteria.statement: Creating a same-named Scene in two different Shows yields distinct ids, each bound to its Show, with no rebinding of the earlier Scene.
successCriteria.verification: Harness test creates the same-named Scene in two Shows and asserts distinct ids and one Scene per Show.

successCriteria.statement: The Studio New Scene flow still creates and opens a Scene with the Show-scoped id.
successCriteria.verification: The Studio New Scene browser test passes with the updated id format.

definitionOfDone.statement: CHG-0057 records the Show-scoped Scene id and the deferred Template creation before implementation.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Schema-valid record and deterministic governance compilation.

definitionOfDone.statement: The create-Scene endpoint derives a Show-scoped id.
A focused test proves cross-Show non-collision and the Studio New Scene browser test still passes; the full server suite passes.
definitionOfDone.evidence: server/tests/unit/sceneIdScoping.test.ts, server/tests/e2e/studioNewScene.test.ts and npm run check.

definitionOfDone.statement: Governance, licensing, lint, type-check, focused and full tests, build, dependency audit and diff checks pass before handoff.
definitionOfDone.evidence: npm run governance:check, npm run check, npm run build, npm audit (0 vulnerabilities), ESLint, type-check and git diff --check; the accept commit is verified by its own pull-request Constitution run before merge.
